table.title: Table {{label}}
table.pendingHere: Waiting to sync. The kitchen cannot see this yet.
table.offlineNote: Offline. This is saved on the tablet and sent when the connection returns.

warn.upcoming: This table is booked at {{time}}. You can seat it anyway.
warn.balance: {{amount}} is still owed on this table.

free.note: The tab stays open and moves to "needs resolving" if anything is owed.

late.title: Nobody has arrived
late.body: Reserved {{time}} · nobody has arrived · held until {{until}}
late.noBookingId: This tablet does not know which booking that is. Refresh the floor.

release.difference: “No-show” goes on the diner's record. “They let us know” does not.
release.needsOnline: Releasing a booking needs a connection.

affected.title: Bookings on this table
affected.body: The table is out of service. These people need a phone call — nothing is cancelled automatically.

queue.offline: Offline — actions are saved on this tablet

floor.title: Floor
floor.error: We could not load the floor. Try again.
floor.noBranch: Your account has no branch assigned, so there is no floor to show.

notice.race: Table {{label}} was taken by someone else just now.
notice.raceNamed: Table {{label}} was seated by {{name}} just now.
notice.freedWithBalance: Table {{label}} freed. {{amount}} is still owed — it is in "needs resolving".
notice.seatedOverBooking: Seated. Table {{label}} still has a booking coming.
notice.releasedNoShow: Table {{label}}'s booking was released as a no-show.
notice.releasedCancelled: Table {{label}}'s booking was released. It does not count against them.

unresolved.title: Needs resolving
unresolved.body: These tables were freed with money still owed.

orders.title: Incoming orders
orders.unreachable: The order queue could not be read. That is not the same as no orders waiting.

calls.title: Waiting for a waiter
calls.unreachable: The calls could not be read.

seating.title: Waiting to be seated
seating.todo: Pending seat requests arrive with the seating flow.

conflicts.title: Needs a decision
conflicts.subtitle: These could not be applied. Nothing here resolves on its own.

applyAnyway.outOfService: Mark it out of service anyway

conflicts.applyAnywayNote: “Send it anyway” resends without checking the table's state.

reason.refused: The server would not accept it from the table's current state.

status.occupied: occupied and has an open tab

head.changedBack: Table {{label}} is {{state}} again, but it has been used since
head.unknown: Table {{label}}'s state could not be read

order.title: Order for table {{label}}
order.tabWillOpen: A tab will be opened for this table.
order.sharedExplained: Shared items are split across everyone at the table.
order.tableDefaultCost: Items charged to the table are split across everyone. Pick a person to charge them individually.
order.offlineNote: Offline. This order is saved on the tablet and sent when the connection returns.
order.menuOffline: The menu has not been loaded on this tablet yet, and it cannot be fetched without a connection.
order.noTab: There is no open tab on this table.
order.noTabWhy: A tab opens when a guest scans the code on the table. A waiter's session cannot open one.
order.menuFromCache: Menu from this tablet's own copy. It refreshes when the connection is back.

tab.title: Tab · table {{label}}
tab.none: No tab is open on this table.
tab.closedNote: This tab is closed. The table stays occupied until someone frees it.
tab.cashOffline: Cash cannot be recorded offline. Take the money and record it when the connection returns.
tab.abandonWarn: {{amount}} will be written off and nobody will be asked to pay it.
tab.abandonReason: Written off from the floor screen
tab.offlineUnknown: This table has a tab, but its bill cannot be read without a connection. Do not open a second one.
tab.closingNote: The bill has been asked for. No new items go on.
tab.linesUnknown: The items on this tab could not be read. That is not the same as nothing being ordered.
tab.adjustmentsUnknown: Only what was done from this tablet shows here. The server does not list a tab's discounts back.
tab.noPeople: Nobody has joined this tab yet.
tab.sharesStaffBlind: Who owes what is visible on the diners' phones only. A staff session cannot read that split.
tab.compReasonSeen: The diner sees this reason on their phone.
tab.voidReasonSeen: The diner sees this reason on their phone.

cash.title: Take cash
cash.tipNote: The tip is on top of the balance, not part of it.
cash.confirmLine: Recording {{amount}} against this tab, plus {{tip}} as a tip.
cash.overpaying: That is more than is owed.
cash.partial: {{amount}} will still be owed after this.
cash.notAReceipt: This records the payment in Yalla. The venue's own cash register still issues the receipt.
cash.closed: Paid in full. The tab is closed; the table stays occupied until someone frees it.
cash.failed: We could not record that payment. Nothing was taken.
cash.exceeds: {{requested}} is more than this tab owes. {{remaining}} is left on it. Nothing was recorded.

connection.notWiredHint: The floor is refreshed by polling. Refresh to be sure.

install.title: Install this on the tablet
install.body: Open the browser menu and choose Install. It then opens straight to the floor, and starts without a network.

enrol.title: Set this tablet up
enrol.body: A manager generates a one-time code in the console. Type it here, once. After that the tablet remembers its branch and never shows this screen again.
enrol.revoked: This tablet is no longer enrolled. A manager can revoke one from the console — if a device was lost, for instance. Ask for a new code.
enrol.deviceNameWhy: This is the name a manager picks it out by in the device list.
enrol.codeSpent: That code has already been used. Ask for a new one — a code works exactly once.
enrol.codeWrong: That code was not recognised. Check it and type it again.
enrol.offline: No connection. Setting up needs the server.
enrol.failed: Could not set this device up.

pin.lockedByIdle: The tablet locked itself after a quiet spell. Your work is still here.
pin.sessionEnded: Your shift session ended. Tap your PIN again.
pin.staffIdWhy: A manager can find it in the console. After your first sign-in your name appears here.
pin.locked: Too many wrong PINs. This PIN is locked.
pin.askManager: A manager can clear it from the console.
pin.offline: No connection. Signing in needs the server.

session.handOverHint: Tap to sign out and hand the tablet over.
